entries.claim_boundary: This exact compact-Cauchy theorem identifies the full Sobolev adjoint kernel of the right-elliptic canonical constraint map with the five lifted H, P_x and J_i stabilizers. It does not make the constraint-plus-gauge operator Fredholm, prove the nonlinear AMM slice, classify bounded spacetime resonances, construct causal evolution, or make a quantum claim.

dispersion.statement: This is a spatial Cauchy adjoint theorem, not a frequency-shell theorem.

lee_wald.statement: The canonical Hamiltonian transpose identity identifies the adjoint kernel with the stabilizer of the background phase-space point.

resonance.statement: Temporal resonance functionals belong to a different correction carrier.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: Exact stabilizer necessity is certified, but bounded spacetime resonance sufficiency is a separate theorem.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded evolution map is analyzed.

smooth_secular.statement: The compact-Cauchy adjoint theorem does not construct a secular correction.

taub_maps.statement: Exactly five independent Taub covectors occur: H, P_x and the three globally lifted J_i.
